nodes.name: MCP Server Trigger
nodes.notes: Header auth keeps this endpoint from being reached around the U4A sidecar. It is not what authorizes agents — the sidecar does that, before anything gets here. Copy the PRODUCTION URL into UMA_PEP_UPSTREAM.

nodes.name: get_invoices
nodes.notes: A read. Name it in tools.json under its own resource id so the owner can put it in a tier of its own.

nodes.name: issue_refund
nodes.notes: An act with consequences. This is the one that belongs on a tier the owner marked ask-me, and the reason tools are split rather than exposed as one endpoint.

meta.description: A starter MCP server shaped for U4A. Two tools on purpose: one read and one act with consequences, so the owner has something worth splitting across tiers. Import it, replace the tools with your own, activate it, then put the U4A sidecar in front — see integrations/n8n/README.md.
